identity.name: The Bone & Joint Journal
identity.publisher: The British Editorial Society of Bone & Joint Surgery
identity.source_note: Clean server-rendered HTML fetched via the README curl recipe (19,444 normalized chars). The guide states content/blinding/limits but defers detailed manuscript preparation (reference formatting, fonts) to the 'Ortho Publish' tool at orthopublish.org.uk, so several formatting fields are not specified on the page — see encoding_notes.

encoding_notes: BJJ explicitly no longer publishes case reports ('The Bone & Joint Journal is no longer publishing Case Reports and they will be rejected without review'), so only original_research is encoded. Infographics (approx 300 words, <=10 references) are accepted but have no clean ARTICLE_TYPES slot and are omitted.

Guide-stated hard limits: whole manuscript <=4000 words INCLUDING abstract, body, and references; abstract <=300 words; <=8 authors; <=10 figures (counting a/b/c parts separately); <=8 tables (table text does not count toward the word limit).
Abstract is structured with subheadings 'Aims', 'Methods', 'Results', 'Conclusion' (max 300 words).

sections encodes the guide's stated single-document element list ('complete manuscript including abstract, introduction, main text, references, tables and acknowledgments'); the whole manuscript is uploaded as ONE Word .doc file, so tables.placement is in_text (tables live inside the manuscript document). 'Main Text' is the guide's own generic heading; it does not prescribe explicit IMRAD body headings for the main text.

Blinding: 'your main document should be completely blinded and all identifying information should be on a separate title page.' double_blind is inferred from the completely-blinded main document; separate_title_page and scrub_body_identifiers are guide-stated; scrub_metadata true is an operational inference for blinding compliance.

REFERENCES BLOCK IS LARGELY UNVERIFIED: the BJJ instructions page states no reference style, in-text marker, ordering, journal-abbreviation, or DOI rule — it defers manuscript preparation to the Ortho Publish tool (orthopublish.org.uk). The schema requires non-null values for style/in_text/order/journal_abbrev/include_doi, so these are placeholder defaults (style 'custom', in_text 'bracket', order 'cited', journal_abbrev 'nlm', include_doi false) and MUST be treated as unverified pending the Ortho Publish spec; et_al_threshold and max_count left null.

LAYOUT FONT/SPACING NOT STATED: the page specifies no font, size, line spacing, margins, line numbers, page numbers, or running head. The schema requires a non-null font and line_spacing, so font 'Times New Roman' 12 and line_spacing 'double' are standard-manuscript-submission placeholders (unverified); line_numbers 'none', page_numbers.show false, and running_head.show false reflect 'not requested by the guide'; page_size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, headings are null.

Figures are uploaded individually to ScholarOne; composite figures must be split into separate images (1a, 1b, 1c); each figure needs a full descriptive legend. formats jpeg/tiff are taken from the guide's illustration/infographic guidance (no distinct format stated for standard figures); legends_location figure_legends_section is a best-fit default (the guide requires a per-figure legend but does not state its location); min_dpi, callout_style, and naming_pattern not stated (null).

Declarations: ethical approval by an IRB/ethics board must be stated in the manuscript; patient consent must be obtained for all human studies and stated in the manuscript; ICMJE conflict-of-interest disclosure documents are required and a COI statement is published — all three required. RCTs must be prospectively registered (trial registration), captured here as a note rather than a declaration-block item.

misc.orcid_required false: authors are asked/encouraged to add an ORCID iD 'if available', not required. cover_letter_required false: no cover letter requirement stated. issn, title_case, highlights, running-title and title length limits, and author-degree handling are not stated (null). Preprints are not permitted and are out of formatting scope.
